measurement_scripts.term2-startup.py:
import subprocess, time, os, resource, tempfile, json
root='/workspace/term2/.worktrees/ci-fresh'
results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='term2-startup-') as home:
  for repeat in range(3):
    for mode in (['plain','source','all'] if repeat % 2 == 0 else ['all','source','plain']):
      for state in ['cold','warm']:
        cache=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=mode+'-',dir=home) if state=='cold' else cache
        args=['node',root+'/dist/cli'+('' if mode=='plain' else '-'+mode)+'.js','--help']
        before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN); start=time.monotonic()
        p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=home,env={**os.environ,'HOME':home,'USERPROFILE':home,'NODE_COMPILE_CACHE':cache},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
        after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
        row={'repeat':repeat,'mode':mode,'cache':state,'wall_s':time.monotonic()-start,'user_s':after.ru_utime-before.ru_utime,'system_s':after.ru_stime-before.ru_stime,'maxrss_kb':after.ru_maxrss,'status':p.returncode,'stdout_bytes':len(p.stdout),'stderr':p.stderr[-2000:]}
        results.append(row); print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
with open('/tmp/term2-startup-results.json','w') as f: json.dump(results,f,indent=2)

import subprocess, time, os, resource, json, sys
name=sys.argv[1]
command=sys.argv[2:]
before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);start=time.monotonic()
with open('/tmp/'+name+'.log','w') as out:
 p=subprocess.run(command,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env={**os.environ,'CI':'1','NODE_ENV':'test','pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run':''},timeout=600)
after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
row={'command':command,'wall_s':time.monotonic()-start,'user_s':after.ru_utime-before.ru_utime,'system_s':after.ru_stime-before.ru_stime,'maxrss_kb':after.ru_maxrss,'status':p.returncode}
with open('/tmp/'+name+'.resources.json','w') as f:json.dump(row,f,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(row))
sys.exit(p.returncode)
